exposure: type of delivery (vaginal or cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 273 neonates born before 37 weeks of gestational age in educational hospitals in Neyshabur, Eastern Iran, between 2017 and 2019.
finding: The prevalence of preterm birth in Neyshabur was 2.85%, with bicornuate uterus, cervical insufficiency, umbilical cord prolapse, placental adhesion, and breech presentation being among the most common associated factors.
mod_finding: A significant difference was observed between the length of pregnancy and the type of delivery (Vaginal or cesarean section).
